subject.title: WORKING: All Microsoft Issues and PRs (refresh)

question: Should OpenClaw own a versioned Microsoft tracker plus a script that can update GitHub PR bodies, or should this remain an external/ClawSweeper-maintained triage workflow?
rationale: The answer determines whether the repository should accept a permanent operational workflow and GitHub mutation capability; it cannot be safely inferred from a contributor implementation or automated review.

options.title: Keep it outside core
options.body: Use existing GitHub searches and ClawSweeper triage reports for Microsoft tracking, and do not merge this repository document or PR-body updater.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded repository tool
options.body: Approve a non-mutating, deterministically verified generator with an explicit owner and documented maintenance contract; keep PR-body updates out of the first version.

options.title: Approve the full workflow
options.body: Accept a reviewed PR-body update capability only with escaping safeguards, deterministic checks, audit-proof, and a named operational owner.

recommendation.title: Keep it outside core
recommendation.body: Use existing GitHub searches and ClawSweeper triage reports for Microsoft tracking, and do not merge this repository document or PR-body updater.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is product and repository-operations direction, and the timeline directly routes the active tracker discussion to this contact.
